use.zh-CN: 为部分握持任务提供支撑感觉
use.en: Provides support during some gripping tasks

caution.zh-CN: 不用于掩盖持续疼痛，避免缠得过紧
caution.en: Do not use to mask persistent pain; avoid excessive tightness

evidenceScope.zh-CN: 厂商目录仅用于识别类别。配件安全与承重须逐型号查手册；没有“增肌效果”分数。
evidenceScope.en: Manufacturer catalogs identify categories only. Check each model manual for ratings and safe use; no hypertrophy score is assigned.
